Remark
[Curvature-operator norm from sectional curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0131 ↗ rem:pet-ch3-ex-29 ↗ def:pet-ch3-curvature-operator

1. ch3:3.4.30Using section 3, show the norm of the curvature operator on $\Lambda ^2T_pM$ is bounded, $|\mathfrak R|_p\le c(n)|\sec |_p$, for a constant $c(n)$ depending only on dimension, where $|\sec |_p$ is the largest absolute value of a sectional curvature at $p$.
